issues.title: The JSON field `"loottable"` of `FDAddTableLootModifier` has been changed.
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.3.4

### NeoForge version

21.1.250

### Description

In Farmer's Delight-1.21.1-neoforge-1.3.4, the JSON field name expected by `FDAddTableLootModifier` has been changed from `"lootTable"` to `"table"`. Any datapack or addon mod that uses the `farmersdelight:fd_add_table` loot modifier type and still writes `"lootTable"` in its JSON will silently fail.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a datapack containing the following loot modifier JSON:
`{
  "type": "farmersdelight:add_loot_table",
  "conditions":
  [
    {
      "condition": "neoforge:loot_table_id",
      "loot_table_id": "minecraft:chests/bastion_bridge"
    }
  ],
  "lootTable": "youmodid:add"
}`
2. Register it in global_loot_modifiers.json.
3. Open a Bastion Bridge chest.
4. Expected: extra loot from the youmodid:add loot table is added.
5. **Actual:** Nothing happens. Changing the field name to `"table"` resolves the issue.

issues.title: [Critical] Gleaming Salad Block could be duplicated by Sticky Piston
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1 & 1.20.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.3.3

### NeoForge version

21.1.238

### Description

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/13207701-d26e-4c25-a034-0b799348ec80

### Steps to reproduce

_No response_

### Mod list

Only Farmer's Delight

### Logs

### Code Analysis

https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/blob/71abf1c05029ccf931190964a87a0eab19da3560/src/main/java/vectorwing/farmersdelight/common/registry/ModBlocks.java#L333-L334

In 1.21.1, `Blocks.OAK_PLANKS` does not have the block properties `pushReaction(PushReaction.DESTROY)`, but `Blocks.CAKE` and `Blocks.PUMPKIN` have. When a Sticky Piston is unextended, it adds the food block into a b36 Blocks List. Then the Gleaming Salad Block was destroyed and dropped Gleaming Salad. Then the b36 Blocks List was recovered to Blocks, making the Gleaming Salad Block recover.

In 1.20.1, this bug is worse, as many food blocks fully copy the block properties of `Blocks.OAK_PLANKS`.

To fix, add `.pushReaction(PushReaction.DESTROY)` in the block properties of the Gleaming Salad Block.

### The worst part is that this bug happens in almost every Farmer's Delight Addon that has a Block Form Food.  An announcement should be made in the Changelog.

issues.title: [Suggestion/Improvement] Backstabbing enchantment condition
Cooking Pot compares meal stacks without checking data components
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.3.2

### NeoForge version

21.1.221

### Description

The Cooking Pot currently compares the stored meal against the recipe result using `ItemStack.isSameItem()` instead of `ItemStack.isSameItemSameComponents()`.

In 1.21, this method only compares the item registry and does not take data components into account. As a result, two stacks of the same item with different components may be treated as equivalent and merged into the same stored stack, preserving the components of the existing meal.

Some addons, such as Extra Delight, define dynamic food variants through data components, including their identity and displayed contents. However, the current block entity and recipe APIs do not provide addons with a non-invasive way to supply an additional compatibility check. Supporting these items therefore requires modifying or injecting into the Cooking Pot block entity itself.

I believe the intended behavior is to compare both the item and its data components, similarly to how the 1.20 branch uses `isSameItemSameTags()`. In 1.21, the corresponding check would appear to be `ItemStack.isSameItemSameComponents()`.

### Steps to reproduce

1. install Extra Delight
2. use sugar * 3 and lemon *3 to cook a lemon jam
3. put another 3 sugar and 3 apples in the cooking pot without taking out the lemon jam
4. the cooking process would start and the result would become 2 lemon jam

### Mod list

1. Farmer's Delight
2. Extra Delight

issues.title: Crash on Player Join: IllegalStateException: Unknown component type named farmersdelight:backstabbing in NeoForge 1.21.1
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.3.2

### NeoForge version

21.1.233

### Description

When a player joins a NeoForge 1.21.1 server running FlectonePulse v1.10.1, the Netty IO thread crashes with an IllegalStateException. This happens because the internal PacketEvents library bundled with FlectonePulse does not recognize custom Data Components registered by mods, specifically farmersdelight:backstabbing from the Farmer's Delight mod.
This error spams the console for every player join and may lead to network instability or DoS vulnerabilities due to unhandled exceptions in the Netty event loop.

issues.title: Ticking World Deadlock: tomato_on_rope missing ropelogged property in farmersdelight:tomatos_on_ropes.
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.3.x (even on 1.3.2 possibly)

### NeoForge version

21.1.228

### Description

Placing a rope above growing tomatoes causes an immediate, hard system deadlock/ticking world crash on NeoForge 1.21.1 running Farmer's Delight 1.3.x. The game completely freezes and must be force-killed via Task Manager or Ctrl+alt+Delete (if in fullscreen mode that is).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Plant tomato seeds and let them grow on rich soil farmland (this probably happens with vanilla farmland as well).
2. Place ropes directly above them to have them start climbing the ropes.
3. Wait for a random tick or use bone meal to trigger the transition to the higher ropes (the second rope block above the adjacent rope block above the tomato crop block).
4. up to 45 or so seconds later the game should freeze you in place due to the server thread deadlocking you into place.

issues.title: (MINOR ISSUE) (HELP) Cabinets using the Chest GUI
issues.body: Hello, forgive me if if this issue has been posted already. I looked for a little bit and didn't find anything. I just need help understanding if the Cabinets title in the GUI can be removed. The Cabinets use Minecraft's chest GUI, but it uses an independent container title in the top left and this can overlap with custom resource packs like my own. Is there a way to edit or remove this text? Thanks. The first picture is a cabinet with my custom resource pack GUI. The second is a Vanilla Chest with the game GUI.

issues.title: holding knife in offhand and using with cutting board doesn't work
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.3.1 - 1.21.1

### NeoForge version

21.1.228

### Description

you could in the past, have, have a knife in one hand, and an ingredient in the other. And then whilst looking at a cutting board, quickly place and cut all the items you were holding.

Now that is not possible

### Steps to reproduce

look at cuttingboard
have knife in offhand
have a stack of some ingredient selected, like cabbage,

try to cut by simply right clicking repeatedly, stacks will instead be placed

### Mod list

tested with ONLY Farmers delight installed

### Logs

_No response_

issues.title: Crash in 1.20.1 due to improper jarJar bundle setting
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.20.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.3

### NeoForge version

47.1.3 (Forge)

### Description

This is the same issue with #1284 , but with a bit analysis.
After depacking the .jar file published, it is worthy to mention that `META-INF/jarjar` folder did not exist.
Hence, as MixinExtras, as a external library bundled with jarjar, doesn't get bundled due to this issue, the game crashes by cannot load MixinExtras' class.

This issue may caused by improper jarJar configuration (which could not be found), or just the wrong jar is uploaded.
Hint: when jarJar is present, the product jar is no longer `build/reobfJar/output.jar`, but `build/reobfJarJar/output.jar` instead.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Launch the game
2. Crash

issues.title: Feasts may disappear on Create contraptions, they should be added to the `create:brittle` block tag

labels.name: integration
labels.description: Relates to interactions with other mods

issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.10

### NeoForge version

21.1.219

### Description

Some blocks have been rightfully added to the `create:brittle` block tag, and I think that all feasts should be included as well because they, in a quite chaotic way, rely on the block below for support. So, depending on how a contraption is assembled, these feasts *may* disappear.

I must note that **Cake** itself is added to the `create:brittle` tag by Create itself, likely for this reason.

In this gif, the **Chocolate Pie** has been given the `create:brittle` block tag, but the **Apple Pie**, **Sweet Berry Cheesecake**, and **Rice Roll Medley** have not.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d26fde0e-086c-4f37-8499-195568495a1d)

This is similar to https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/pull/1933 , in where whole Pancake stacks disappear for similar reasons.



I did try to make a commit, but I think that for the sake of preventing similar oddities, a *block* tag including all feasts could be added and included in `create:brittle`.

### Steps to reproduce

- Place any feast on a Create contraption, glued and ready to be assembled. I recommend a vertical windmill formation so all sides can be accounted for.
- Assemble the Contraption and notice the feasts have been destroyed.
- Unassemble the contraption to confirm this.
   - If they have not disappeared... repeat again, placing the feasts elsewhere. It depends purely in the order the blocks are parsed, which is at least *somewhat* consistent.
   - For example, I had consistent results placing the feasts on the north-east quadrant of a vertical windmill.

issues.title: Fried Egg recipe should use `#c:eggs`
issues.body: Currently, the Fried Egg recipe (and its unlock advancement) only checks for `minecraft:egg`. This makes it incompatible with various modded eggs in the `c:eggs` tag (e.g. Warm Eggs and Cold Eggs in Vanilla Backport)

issues.title: [1.20.1] The usage logic of the cutting board seems to be problematic.
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.20.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.9

### NeoForge version

47.33.22

### Description

When the main hand is holding food, if the off-hand has an item, the character will prioritize eating the food when not full, and prioritize placing the off-hand item when full. As a result, when the off-hand is holding an item that can be placed on the cutting board, it becomes impossible to place food from the main hand onto the cutting board under any circumstances. This makes using the cutting board very troubling when holding torches in the off-hand. Besides, when holding food in the off-hand and holding item in the main hand, item will also be placed instead of food. issues.title: Dough may be accidentally tagged as `forge:dough/wheat` (not plural)

labels.name: integration
labels.description: Relates to interactions with other mods

issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.9

### NeoForge version

21.1.216

### Description

The title is self-explanatory. Farmer's Delight's Dough is tagged as `forge:dough/wheat` (not plural).
Create seems to use both `c:doughs` and `c:doughs/wheat` to tag its own dough with. So, while other tags are present that mitigate this, and the tag `forge:dough` is rarely used from my experience, the two types of dough _may_ be mutually exclusive in some circumstances.

The reason why I think this is an oversight is because tags are [conventionally recommended to be plural](https://docs.neoforged.net/docs/resources/server/tags/#finding-and-naming-tags).

And just as an addendum, although the conversion is automatically handled by NeoForge, it should also be using the `c` ("common") namespace.

### Steps to reproduce

_No response_

### Mod list

Farmer's Delight, Create (for example)

issues.title: [1.21.1] Crash with Create & JEI: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in AnimatedSpout

labels.name: integration
labels.description: Relates to interactions with other mods

issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.9

### NeoForge version

21.1.213

### Description

The game crashes when attempting to view recipes in JEI that involve the Create mod's Spout mechanics (or simply browsing JEI categories). The crash occurs specifically when Farmer's Delight is installed alongside Create and JEI.

The error is `java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 0 out of bounds for length 0` located at `com.simibubi.create.compat.jei.category.animations.AnimatedSpout.draw`.

It seems that a fluid recipe or container added by Farmer's Delight might be interacting incorrectly with Create's Spout animation rendering in JEI, causing it to try and access an empty fluid list. The crash does not happen on the first page of Spout recipes, only when navigating to the second page.

I have tested this on a minimal instance with only Create, JEI, and Farmer's Delight, and the crash persists. Removing Farmer's Delight resolves the issue.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Launch the game with the minimal mod set (Create, JEI, Farmer's Delight).
2. Open the inventory to access the JEI overlay.
3. Search for "Spout" (Create) and right-click it to view the "Spout Filling" recipe category.
4. Observe that there are multiple pages of recipes (specifically 6 pages in my case).
5. The first page renders correctly.
6. Click the arrow button to navigate to the **2nd page**.
7. The game crashes immediately upon rendering the 2nd page.

### Mod list

- create-1.21.1-6.0.8.jar
- FarmersDelight-1.21.1-1.2.9.jar
- jei-1.21.1-neoforge-19.25.1.328.jar
- flywheel-neoforge-1.21.1-1.0.5.jar

issues.title: [1.20] Cooking Pot Recipe - Allow for NBT-Sensitive containers
issues.body:
Cooking pot recipes don't allow for NBT-Sensitive containers, at least in the 1.20 version. _I checked the 1.21 version and the implementation was different, so I don't know if it works differently there_

This is a hindrance in my use case, where I want to use water bottles (and specifically _water_ bottles) as the container for my recipes.

As an example, by not allowing NBT-Sensitive containers, I can use any `minecraft:potion` (be it water, fire resistance, or instant damage) as the container.

A naive way of implementing this would be having a set of (NBT/NBT Path,REQUIRED|REQUIRE NOT)(configurable, default empty) that have to match on the given container.

But a true/false for nbt sensitivity could also be fine.

labels.name: integration

issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

FarmersDelight-1.21.1-1.2.9

### NeoForge version

21.1.209

### Description

The server has a specific "crash chunk" that, when loaded by any player, causes an immediate server crash.

The server was running fine for hours during exploration. One player entered a new chunk and the server immediately crashed. Now, that player cannot log back in, as their login attempt loads the problematic chunk and triggers the crash loop. Any other player who approaches this same area also crashes the server.

The crash is a `java.lang.ClassCastException` in `RuPlantBlock.java` (line 63). The stack trace shows it is triggered by a `randomTick` from a Farmer's Delight `RichSoilBlock`.

The world was pre-generated with Chunky, which did not cause any crashes. This confirms the issue is related to **block ticking** and not world generation.

**Crash Location:**
The crash is reliably triggered when loading the area around coordinates `x=-453, z=-6533`.

### Steps to reproduce

Since it happened randomly and not by player action, I can't state exactly what combination of blocks, items or actions are needed to reproduce the error, but the log does points towards a conflict between Farmer's Delight and Regions Unexplored. It appears to be a random combination of blocks or items ticking when a player is present.

```diff
private static boolean hasWater(LevelReader level, BlockPos pos) {
+  BlockState state = level.getBlockState(pos);
  for (BlockPos nearbyPos : BlockPos.betweenClosed(pos.offset(-4, 0, -4), pos.offset(4, 1, 4))) {
-    if (level.getFluidState(nearbyPos).is(FluidTags.WATER)) {
+    if (state.canBeHydrated(level, pos, level.getFluidState(nearbyPos), nearbyPos))
      return true;
    }
  }
  return FarmlandWaterManager.hasBlockWaterTicket(level, pos);
}
```
Similarly to what NeoForge does in [FarmBlock.java.patch](https://github.com/neoforged/NeoForge/blob/1.21.x/patches/net/minecraft/world/level/block/FarmBlock.java.patch) to avoid the existing _Water_ hardcoding.

### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.8

### NeoForge version

### Description

The Cooking Pot's result display is allowed to store 99 items instead of 64.

You cannot change the `burnTime` property for items.  This is likely due to the field being marked as final here: <https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/blob/1.20/src/main/java/vectorwing/farmersdelight/common/item/FuelItem.java>.

ItemEvents.modification(event => {

});

# Do not post suggestions in the issues board!

This board is meant to log **problems with the mod** only. Issues must be resolvable so they can be closed once the problem is fixed. Suggestions end up polluting the board, making it harder to keep track of things.

If you would like to propose ideas for the mod, please use the **Discussions** tab. In it, posts can be upvoted, and you can reply individually to messages, making it a better place to discuss ideas.

issues.title: Knife duping bug
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.20.1 Forge

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.7

### NeoForge version

Forge 47.4.0

### Description

When you pick up a cutting board with CarryOn, if you have a knife stabbed in the cutting board, it gives you the knife. However, when you put it back down, the knife is still there. This might be a CarryOn problem, but I thought i'd mention it here. Editing this, I just discovered that they actually delete themselves, so it's not really a problem.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Put down the cutting board

3. Pick up the cutting board with CarryOn
4. Put the cutting board back down

Since V1.2.5, Melons and Pumpkins can now be broken quickly by knives, so would it be too far of a stretch for Cactus to be as well?

It's just a small little thing I thought of about seven minutes ago and I didn't see anything else that asked about it so I wanted to throw the idea out there for you to grab if you do so choose.

issues.title: CuttingBoardRecipeWrapper thows exception in simple scenario - crashes server
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.5

### NeoForge version

21.1.74

### Description

CuttingBoardRecipeWrapper is throwing exception when there is no item for index 1, resulting in crash of server.
This should be handled better, and can be easily crashed by using a dispenser with a tool on a cutting board.


### Steps to reproduce

Placed Dispenser facing into a Cutting Board.  Dispenser contained a tool (Diamond Paxel) that is known to cut Amethyst Block on a Cutting Board.  Cutting Board is fed Amethyst Blocks from Hopper on the opposite side of the Dispenser.  Redstone Clock block is placed below the dispenser and a lever placed on it.  Manually using the Paxel will work on the Amethyst Block to craft the recipe, however turning the lever on to automated the crafting throws the exception - crashing the server.

issues.title: Fully grown tomato crops display as transparent on maps
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.20.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.5

### NeoForge version

Forge - 47.2.0

### Description

The block farmersdelight:tomatoes displays as transparent on maps. Notably, this is not an issue for the block farmersdelight:budding_tomatoes, which displays correctly as a shade of green on maps. This can be confusing, as it can make it look like all the tomatoes you planted have vanished when viewed on a map, as well as just looking aesthetically unpleasing.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Plant a tomato crop.
2. Bonemeal it, or wait until it is fully grown.
3. Make a map, or view it on minimap or worldmap mod.

### Mod list

Xaero's Minimap

issues.title: Sweeping Edge can be applied to both Knives and Skillets despite not working at all
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.5

### NeoForge version

21.1.79

### Description

In recent 1.21 versions of the mod, all knives and the skillet item can receive the Sweeping Edge enchantment, despite the enchantment having no effect on anything except for a sword.

This is likely occurring due to tagging the items within the minecraft:enchantable/sword tag, which in vanilla is used for Looting, Knockback, and for Sweeping Edge. Attempting this bug on versions prior to 1.21 (tested with 1.2.5 of Farmer's Delight but on 1.20.1 of NeoForge) results in the items being flagged as incompatible with Sweeping Edge, further proving the tags being the issue.

The easiest solution would be to simply remove the items from the sword tag, but this method would also remove Looting and Knockback from being able to be applicable to them. Unfortunately, one would have to edit the compatibility of Looting and Knockback directly (via editing the enchantment json) into a new tag in order for it to be allowed on Swords, Skillets, and Knives, which could cause some trouble for other mods/datapacks' compatibility down the line.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Load into a 1.21 NeoForge world with Farmers Delight.
2. Obtain any knife and a skillet
3. With commands enabled, use the command `/enchant (target selector: self) minecraft:sweeping_edge 3` when holding the knife and when holding the skillet (If testing on versions prior to 1.21, use the enchantment idea of `minecraft:sweeping`)
4. Both items should now receive the enchantment.
5. Spawn a group of mobs to attack with the enchanted items
6. Observe that the sweeping effect does not occur at all, as the enchantment only modifies the base effect from swords, not applying the sweeping attack itself to the item.

### Mod list

Farmer's Delight

This feels like a minor oversight, which is why I'm not writing a bug report for this as much as I'm suggesting that it be added.

issues.title: Mixin Injection Failure (KeepRichSoilGiantTreeMixin) When running build
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.20.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.4

### NeoForge version

47.2.0

### Description

I'm attempting to make a Farmer's Delight addon for mycology and mushroom foraging. Every time I attempt to run the environment, the build fails. I looked into it and found that the Mixin KeepRichSoilGiantTreeMixin is experiencing an injection failure. Maybe I'm missing something stupid and simple here, just hoping you guys can help me figure this out, or at least point me in the right direction. 

### Steps to reproduce

1) Run the client 
2) Build fails 

### Mod list

Only Farmer's Delight, as it is meant to be the base mod for this addon.

issues.body: As the title says. if stack.getItem() instanceof BlockItem block

1.2.4

any supported

If there is one visitor who is more annoying than pillagers, it's the wandering trader. It would be a cool feature, if throwing a rotten tomato at a wandering trader causes him to run away (despawn)

Example:
1. Wandering trader groans in your ear and stands directly on the block you want to build on.

issues.title: i keep getting this issue: Internal Exception: com.google.gson.JsonParseException: Error loading registry data: Unknown element: ResourceKey(minecraftworldgen/configured_feature farmersdelight:patch_wild_beetroots] /
vectorwing/farmersdelight/common/Configuration will never receive config events
issues.body:
https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/blob/1.19/src/main/java/vectorwing/farmersdelight/common/Configuration.java#L9

I was writing some mods when referring to code stucture Farmer's Delight on "how should I do this" questions.  
However, I found my configuration handler never receives configuration event.  
After some looking around, I found configuration events are fired on **mod event bus**, and annotation `@Mod.EventBusSubscriber` by default makes the class listen to **forge event bus**, so current code (and possibly all code since 1.16.5) never receive config events.  
To make it really receive events, annotation should be written like this.  
```
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = FarmersDelight.MODID, bus = Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.MOD)
```
It seems that Farmer's delight never really do something on these events, but I think it important to point it out.

### Minecraft version

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.4

### Forge version

47.2.17

### Description

An issue from emi's page. They told me the following is a bug with Farmers Delight:
EMI indicates in the recipe that an item has a probability (here 50%) for the recipe (here cutting board) as an output. But in the recipe tree it doesn't show ~8 (4/50%) wild rice like in the fabric version.
![303180673-5ead2d68-2d51-4777-a4f7-2a1a0d7f1650](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/assets/159393991/16b3aefa-4f22-41a9-a448-185459372b76)
![303180667-0929c754-6858-4988-afd6-2b62a136541d](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/assets/159393991/f0fca98b-1b0b-4b92-b0e1-80eeb3ecdb5b)

[https://github.com/emilyploszaj/emi/issues/432](url)

### Steps to reproduce

Open the inventory
Look for a recipe with a percentaged output like shovel-digging gravel on a cutting board (did you want the duplication-glitch?)
Press the button with the four squares next to the recipe.

issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.20.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.3

### Forge version

47.2.0

### Description

The Sweet Berry Cookie has two recipes, one using Sweet Berries and Wheat, and one with Honey and Wheat. I assume this is a mix-up with the Honey Cookies, which have their own recipe using Honey and Wheat but which is instead shapeless.

### Steps to reproduce

Check the recipes for Sweet Berry Cookies using a browser such as JEI.

issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.19.2

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.3

### Forge version

43.3.5

### Description

For example, making Cooked Rice works only if a single slot has rice. If i put rice into 2, or more, it just does not work.

This makes it impossible to automate with AE2.

I suggest an option, where you can "lock" a specific recipe to each pot, which will make the pot only accept a stack of each ingredient, and the slots, that are not used will not accept anything.
Like in this image.
![image](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/assets/124529188/93c75539-dc0a-4f3e-8b2d-4f3de904598e)
This way, you can automate the crafting of the items using AE2, or even just vanilla hoppers.
Later, the "locked" recipe can be changed, if the player wants to.

Another thing:
If a recipe needs 2, or 3 of the same thing (like Beetroot Soup, Tomato Sauce, Chorus Juice), allow the crafting of the item, if the needed ingredients are in the same slot.
For example, make this a valid recipe:
![image](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/assets/124529188/3aeee2f4-d161-4e1d-8c0f-2a84aaf7cd38)

issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.18.2

### Farmer's Delight version

### Forge version

40.2.10

### Description

User tried to interact with a cutting board and was crashed out of the server. Another user on the server who was in the same vicinity of the cutting board was also unable to log in to the server after the first user crashed. Two other users on the server who were not near the cutting board were able to join the server without issue.

### Steps to reproduce

1. User A set down cutting board and interreacted with it which prompted crash
2. User B who was in the area of the cutting board also crashed and tried re-joining the server to remove the cutting board but kept crashing

issues.title: Feature Request / Discussion: Emitting events when a food finishes cooking with a reference to the player who cooked it.
issues.body:
I started making a compat mod for this and Project MMO but I ran into a snag with the different cooking blocks. The main issue I had was not having a reference to the player who placed the food anywhere in those methods. I wanted to see if you would be open to emitting events when a food is processed or cooked by one of your blocks, and if that event could have a reference to the food that was cooked and the player that placed it. 

This would make it a lot easier for others to extend or create expansions for the mod as well for events that need to know when an item has processed through your mod.

I wasn't sure if you knew of a way currently to get access to the player in a place after the food has finished cooking? I can also implement this compat mod with mixins, which I have working in the `StoveTopEntityBlock`'s `cookAndOutputItems` method. Just no access to the player who placed the items is a bummer.

issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.20.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.3

### Forge version

47.1.43

### Description

Hello there :)

I'm not sure if it's a bug or a wanted feature, but I noticed, that ropes over tomatoes get destroyed when right-click harvesting them (no matter if with or without knife). By destroyed I mean, that the blocks of the tomato vines stay, but the rope completely vanishes not even leaving an item drop behind and as soon as I harvest the next plant the grown vines also get destroyed.

I have my tomato farm set up as follows:

A slim rectangle of logs in the ground containing 1xfield length rich soil farmland plus some spots where I put water so it can apply the bonemeal effect. I set up fence posts at the beginning and end of the field 4 blocks high with "overhangs" connecting them. the ropes for each plant hang down from there. There is no block of space between the plants, so the ropes connect creating a loosely webbed structure that vanishes as soon as the vines grow.

When I harvest a grown vine and then harvest the next vine of the connecting rope block both ropes disappear and at least one of the grown vine blocks gets destroyed. If not immediately the vine block that survives gets destroyed with the next harvest.

The order of harvesting tomatoes I use:

Tried different ones. as long as it's only a bush without vines harvesting them with or without knife works fine. As soon as I grow vines with one or two ropes the issue described happens. When I start with the upper vine the rope disappears, when I harvest the middle vine both vines get destroyed including the ropes used. When I harvest the bottom bush at first both upper vines get destroyed dropping the tomatoes but no rope item.

Also I don't receive credit for the Advancement for using ropes to grow tomatoes taller.

Thank for taking a look (or providing me with missing info ^^)

Best regards,

Rike

### Steps to reproduce

Well...

- plant tomatoes on rich soil farmland and build the setup I described (also works when you only place the ropes without the fences...produced the same 'issue')
- harvest tomatoes by left clicking the vines or the bottom bush with/without a knife

issues.title: French Toast Concept
issues.body:
In real life I use these two recipes for making french toast.

- 3 eggs
- 1 cup of milk
- 2 tbsp sugar
- 5 pieces of bread
AND
- 1 egg
- 1/4 cup of milk
- 2 tbsp sugar
- 2 pieces of bread

These can be converted into minecraft as:

- 3 eggs
- 1 bucket of milk
- 1 or 2 sugar
- 5 bread (slices)
AND
- 1 egg
- 1 milk bottle
- 1 or 2 sugar
- 2 bread (slices)

Making that in the crafting table would then give you 'Dipped Bread' and after putting that in the Skillet or the Cooking Pot you receive French Toast (preferably the Skillet). If you like, I could send some pictures to base the minecraft textures on. Slices was between brackets because maybe you can introduce them into the mod by using the Cutting Board.

Thanks for reading!
LasagneLegend

Similar to https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/issues/777, I've also created a modpack and am running into some forge empty tag recipe issues. issues.title: Refactor cooking recipe containers into recipe data
issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.20.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.3

### Forge version

47.1.47

### Description

Cooking recipes are added via datapack, but their containers are still hardcoded. This would be much more convenient to have in datapack, so it can be read during KubeJS recipe porting.

Here's an analysis of the issue from the perspective of the codebase.

-----------------

Notice how there is no `container` key in this cooking recipe's data file:

https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/blob/ae3aabf76e9d02b5fed419e470b409ef8bcc072b/src/generated/resources/data/farmersdelight/recipes/cooking/squid_ink_pasta.json#L1-L23

When registering bowl items, they are registered as a `bowlFoodItem` to take bowls as recipe remainders. There is seemingly no input for the container from the recipe data:

https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/blob/ae3aabf76e9d02b5fed419e470b409ef8bcc072b/src/main/java/vectorwing/farmersdelight/common/registry/ModItems.java#L356-L357

https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/blob/ae3aabf76e9d02b5fed419e470b409ef8bcc072b/src/main/java/vectorwing/farmersdelight/common/registry/ModItems.java#L29-L31

And vice-versa for `drinkItem`:

https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/blob/ae3aabf76e9d02b5fed419e470b409ef8bcc072b/src/main/java/vectorwing/farmersdelight/common/registry/ModItems.java#L212-L213

labels.name: integration
labels.description: Relates to interactions with other mods

issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.20.1

### Farmer's Delight version

FarmersDelight-1.20.1-1.2.3

### Forge version

47.1.44

### Description

Minecolonies does not recognise Farmer's Delight foods as foods. There are two buildings that have a list of allowed foods and no Farmer's Delight foods appear on these lists. I have Pam's in the modpack and Minecolonies recognises their foods and they are on the lists.
I asked on the Minecolonies discord what was wrong and they said that Minecolonies looks at all the items in the creative tabs, and uses all of the food items it finds in there. Your foods are in the creative tabs but still not being recognised as food.
The other weirdness is that I can hand-feed a colonist with your food and eat it as a player, so it is a food.

issues.body:
### Minecraft version

1.20.1

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.3

### Forge version

47.1.3

### Description

Whenever I get rice and try to plant it, it states that the crop cannot survive well outside of water even when I'm in the water. 

### Steps to reproduce

1. Obtain rice (through creative mode due to rice plants not spawning)
2. Attempt to place rice on dirt underwater (This also applies to rich soil)

issues.title: Add more farming aspects to Farmer's Delight
issues.body: This post is more of a pull request than an issue, but I couldn't figure out how to post a pull request, so I'm posting it here. Farmer's Delight is a really good food mod, if not the best food mod ever created. But it doesn't really have enough farming aspects to it. More cooking. I want it to 75% farming, 25% cooking, because it's called "Farmer's Delight" not "Chef's Delight". I want there to be a watering can, which you can use to water crops, which in turn, causes crops to grow 10% or 15% faster. There also needs to be Animal Waste and stuff which you can create fertilizer with to boost crop growing speed by 25%. There can also be a rake, which allows you to create farmland in a 3 by 3 square, more efficient than a hoe. There also needs to be other fruits, like bananas. I am unsure if a Farmer's Delight addon adds bananas to the game, but if not, there definitely needs to be a banana. You can create Banana Milkshakes out of it, which gives you a 1:00 speed boost when drank. Now, obviously bananas grow on trees, which there needs to be a banana tree sapling to farm bananas. There you have it. All of my suggestions for Farmer's Delight. I think they're good suggestions, considering that there are not a lot of farming tools in Farmer's Delight. I extremely enjoy this mod, and hope that it gets improved as the days go by.

### Minecraft version

### Farmer's Delight version

1.2.2

### Description

I made a custom modpack for my friends and I to play on a server together, and I have added a lot of different mods. I liked Farmers delight, so I added it. I also added a lot of "food" like mods together. My friend noticed that we cant craft majority of recipes that use the 'forge:milk' tag. issues.title: Compat request: Tetra
issues.body:
Hello, could you add a compatibility with Tetra mod to allow tetra's shortblades and farmer's delight knifes to be able to be recognized as tetra's short blades and for shortblades to be used on chopping boards? Or something like that, I don't feel competent to delve into details. Thanks :)

I know that there is a datapack and an addon, but I feel it would be better to have this capability natively.

[Here is some more info on integrating with tetra](https://github.com/mickelus/tetra/wiki).

issues.title: [Suggestion/Integration idea] "Or" chance based processing when cutting or loot table processing.
issues.body:
I'm currently fiddling with some recipes to do farmers delight styled breakdowns and stripping for bark for the other mods which add types of wood etc in my modpack in 1.19.2.
However I've come upon autumnity which has a log stripping logic where there seems to be around a third chance that the stripped log will become "sappy" rather than plain, the sap then being harvested by a bottle afterwards.

I could make a processing recipe, but it would mean it has to go one way or the other. Because I can't tell it to give me EITHER the sappy or nonsappy stripped log, only one or the other. and if I do a chance to do sappy and chance to do nonsappy together theres a chance I'll get none or both along with my bark. (also making the sap always pop out will make it somewhat op).

Is there a chance you can implement this kind of mechanic (or I just don't know it exists)? or even like, make something thats processed drop out a loot table or something? cause then I could just do up a loot table for it to spit out the log instead.

### Description

Farmer Delight prevents the creation of a minecraft world and access to a world, I know what causes the problem but I do not see how to fix it knowing that I do not want to uninstall any mod, it is what I saw a problem reading a json file, it is impossible for a focntione to retrieve a certain value. As a developer myself, I'm convinced it's just a small value to be changed in one of the mixins/jsons files.

After checking, I found that the problem came from [RER](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/roughly-enough-resources). When I deinstalled REI and its extensions, everything worked fine, but you can understand that I don't want to part with REI and its extensions, and I wanted to see how to solve the problem between your mod and REI and REI extension particulary on RER (responsible of world error creation/access).

issues.title: [Feature Request] Make container accept an Ingredient rather than an ItemStack
issues.body:
This way, a recipe can accept multiple containers rather than making duplicates of the same recipe with a different serving item. 
For example, a modpack dev could make most recipes that use bowls use the forge:bowls tag instead. You could serve your meal in not just a minecraft:bowl but also in an ecologics:coconut_husk.

The recipes in the mod don't have to be changed, the method of checking the remaining item to use as the serving item can still work with this, but defining a custom recipe with an array/tag or Ingredient (I have limited java knowledge so excuse any mistakes) would be massively helpful to people like me.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Add fruits/vegetables and plants to Create: Crafts & Additions tags

labels.name: integration
labels.description: Relates to interactions with other mods

issues.body:
As per the title, I am requesting that Farmer's Delight add its various fruits and vegetables to `#createaddition:plant_foods`, and its various plant items to `#createaddition:plants`. This will allow FD items to be used to make C:C&A biomass, without players/modpack devs needing to add all these items to these tags themselves.~
More specifically...

`#createaddition:plant_foods` should contain
`farmersdelight:cabbage`
`farmersdelight:tomato`
`farmersdelight:onion`

issues.title: Modded Tree Bark Issue
issues.body:
Tree Bark doesn't drop from stripping modded logs on the Cutting Board.
Since you aren't able to get every mod out there, that makes perfect sense. But I would truly appreciate it if you were to add compatibility for the bigger mods out there. (eg, Biomes O' Plenty, Oh The Biomes You'll Go)
and if this were to be possible, it would be neat to add compatibility to smaller but still rather high downloaded mods such as Ecologics. Obviously though, that is quite a stretch, and is just a suggestion if you were to go through with the other requests for compatibility.

Also, completely unrelated issue, but why do tatami mats have two variants? Why not just make it so that there's only one variant (half tatami mat) and make it so that when you're shifting, they don't connect, but when you aren't, they have a connected texture in every direction? (kind of like chests) Just a suggestion.

Edit: Sorry, I am new to GitHub. I can now see I could've wrote this someplace else, so I am sorry if this was disruptive and not deemed a real issue.

issues.body:
### Description

When i try to runClient with intelij, just when i add farmer's delight as dependencies 

### Steps to reproduce

In build.gradle

```
buildscript {
    repositories {
        maven { url = 'https://files.minecraftforge.net' }
        maven {
            url "https://repo.spongepowered.org/repository/maven-public/"
            // content { includeGroup "org.spongepowered" }
        }
        mavenCentral()
    }
    dependencies {
        classpath group: 'net.minecraftforge.gradle', name: 'ForgeGradle', version: '5.1.+', changing: true
        classpath group: 'org.spongepowered', name: 'mixingradle', version: '0.7-SNAPSHOT'
    }
}
```

repositories {
    maven {
        url = "https://www.cursemaven.com"
        content {
            includeGroup "curse.maven"
        }
    }
}

dependencies {

}

issues.title: [1.18.2]: Comfort does not check naturalRegeneration gamerule
issues.body:
### Description

The [comfort effect](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/blob/4471a928c13a018c6a488b40482e22baf8b14096/src/main/java/vectorwing/farmersdelight/common/effect/ComfortEffect.java) does not check if the gamerule `naturalRegeneration` is turned on or not, resulting in some odd behavior when said gamerule is turned off. When saturation is available, no healing occurs, since this is when Minecraft's healing-from-saturation is supposed to occur, but that's turned off by the gamerule. Only when saturation is empty, the player heals "as intended" by the effect, however the gamerule is not respected.

I'm currently tinkering with a hardcore modpack and would like to include Farmer's Delight, though its usefulness is limited in this scenario. If Comfort was disabled entirely when `naturalRegeneration` is turned off, it would reduce the number of useful foods in the mod to 4 - melon juice, fruit salad and mixed salad for regaining 1 heart, and apple cider for absorption. It would be nice if there was a configuration option that could control the heal rate of the Comfort effect when the gamerule is off, maybe with a default of 0, meaning disabled. A separate option for when the gamerule is turned on could be worth considering as well.

It'd also be nice if the nutrition values and effects of each food could be customized. issues.title: [MC Version]: 1.19.2. Shift + clicking non-bowl containers (like glass bottles) in the cooking pot GUI do not place them in the container slot
issues.body:
### Description

Shift + clicking non-bowl serving items (like Glass Bottles) in the cooking pot GUI do not place them in the serving slot. 

Since glass bottles are never used in a cooking recipe except as a serving item, they should also be shift-clicked to the cooking pot's serving slot. 

In order to fix this, I suggest two things:
1.  #farmersdelight:serving_items for items that should always be shift-clicked to the containers slot. This should include bowls, glass bottles, and buckets (Both Nether's Delight and Sully's Mod add meals served in buckets)
2. Serving items of the current meal inside the cooking pot will always be shift-clicked to the container slot.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open Cooking Pot GUI. 
2. Shift Click a glass bottle in your inventory.
3. Notice that it goes inside the food slot instead of the container slot.

issues.title: [1.19.2]: Backstabbing enchantment causing server crash in niche interaction with Primal Magick
issues.body:
### Description

Having a Primal Magick wand in your offhand and using it to cast an offensive spell at an entity's back while a knife with Backstabbing is in your main hand causes a dedicated server to crash. It seems to be something about trying to figure out whether to apply the Backstabbing bonus when the source of the damage is the spell?

I genuinely don't know which mod is to blame for this problem, as both are mentioned in the log/crash and both are technically involved. I'm reporting it to the Primal Magick issue tracker as well just in case.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Have both Primal Magick and Farmer's Delight installed
2. Inscribe a Primal Magick wand with an offensive spell; in this case, I used an earth damage spell
3. Enchant a knife with Backstabbing
4. Equip the knife in your main hand and wand in your offhand
5. Attack an entity from behind by right clicking with the wand
6. Watch the game crash

https://gist.github.com/Not-February/4c46cf5cc47030e3c7fa2bcc1abedfe1

issues.title: [1.18.2+ mod compat request] Spice of Life: Carrot & Sweet Potato compatibility

labels.name: integration
labels.description: Relates to interactions with other mods

issues.body:
Hello, thank you for the mod! It is, indeed, delightful.

I'd like to request that you fire a `LivingEntityUseItemEvent.Finish` each time a player successfully eats directly from a placed food block (PieBlock), but with the item on the event being the corresponding slice rather than the whole pie item. So for example, each time a player successfully eats from a placed Apple Pie block, there would be a `LivingEntityUseItemEvent.Finish` fired that specifies the Player and the Apple Pie Slice item.

This would improve compatibility with "Spice of Life: ___ Edition" mods, which subscribe to that event in order to track which foods each player has eaten. (Sweet Potato Edition [here](https://github.com/tarinoita/Spice-of-Life-Sweet-Potato/blob/1.18/src/main/java/com/tarinoita/solsweetpotato/tracking/FoodTracker.java#L17), Carrot Edition [here](https://github.com/Cazsius/Spice-of-Life-Carrot-Edition/blob/1.18/src/main/java/com/cazsius/solcarrot/tracking/FoodTracker.java#L25).) Currently, neither one will recognize food eaten from a placed block at all, including vanilla Cake, but I plan to change this soon for Sweet Potato Edition.

In the meantime, I believe I can add compatibility within Sweet Potato by listening for the `PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock` and independently computing whether the player can eat from the block or not, but I think the event makes the most sense long-term. Or if you have a better idea, I'm open to suggestions!

I've specified 1.18.2+ because that's all I really care about, but Carrot Edition goes way back, so compatibility could still be worthwhile for earlier versions of FD, if you're up for it.

Thanks for considering!

issues.title: [1.18.2 - FORGE] - Client Crash with "Create" during load.
issues.body:
The new version of Farmer's Delight (1.2.0) that just came out crashes with Create (version 0.5.0.d) while playing 1.18.2 FORGE version 40.1.80. The crash log itself specifically mentions "Failed to load description for particle create:soul_perimeter", which implies that it is an issue with Create itself to me BUT the crash only happens if Farmer's Delight V1.2.0 is installed. Downgrading Farmer's Delight back to V1.1.2 fixes the issue and everything works as expected and normally during load.

However, since this has something to do with the client's GUI it seems like. I assume this is due to an issue with the newly implemented Recipe Book GUIs for the cookpot and other things in 1.2.0... However, if this is just a missing issue on Create's side and this new update just simply opened up the problem, then I do apologize for posting here.

Crash log should be attached.
[crash-2022-09-20_22.07.53-client.txt](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/files/9612387/crash-2022-09-20_22.07.53-client.txt)

issues.title: [1.18.2] Rich Soil gets reverted
issues.body:
**Description**
Rich soil disappears. 
To be more concrete, it turns back to dirt, as soon as any sort of tree grows atop of it. (Dynamic trees don't apply, they cannot grow on righ soil)
I feel like this is a possibly wanted behaviour, but I would prefer to have it toggle on/off in the future. There are some mods like the pokecube one where berry bushes occasionally turn into trees (without my permission, too), and I lose my hard-earned rich soil. 

**Steps to reproduce:**
Place rich soil, plant any type of crop/sapling that turns into a tree. Wait or use bone meal (and equivalents). Observe the rich soil disappear. 

**Expected behavior:**
There is a config file where I can tell it not to do this. Or just don't let it happen at all, if it's not intentional. 

**Logs**
[latest.log](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/files/9610716/latest.log)


**Screenshots**
Can't really add any. Just Rich Soil and in the next moment plop a tree and it's back to dirt.

issues.title: [1.18.2] Bowl Duping With Cooking Pot
issues.body:
Please fill out the template below to describe your issue. Doing so **greatly** helps us understand what happened!

**Description**
Placing stacks of ingredients in the cooking pot, and a stack of bowls lets you create meals that automatically fill up the output slot with a finished meal.  When this slot is full with 16 meals the pot keeps cooking and starts filling up the finished meal slot.  All this time it is kicking out bowls.  When the output slot is full it doesn't use up bowls that are stacked in the bowl slot...but you keep getting bowls when the meals finish. 

Screenshot: https://www.dropbox.com/s/x1njkjpqifb9hlf/2022-09-12_20.35.24.png?dl=0

**Mod list:**
https://pastebin.com/F0wULmPu

This is the Cosmic Magitech Modpack - I'm the owner and we don't do any scripting.

Thank you for helping with the project! Your reports are appreciated!

issues.title: [Suggestion] Visual display of basket contents
issues.body:
The basket is a nice decorative storage block, but it seems a little strange to be able to see through and inside it and not see any items in it when it's full!  
It would be a nice touch to display states of full-ness in a similar manner to compost bins, so it looks like it has a bunch of random items thrown in.

issues.title: Suggestion: Make Bottle > Bucket recipes require 4 bottles of the fluid.
issues.body: The current implementation makes sense for FD in a vacuum or in combination with vanilla. However, once tech mods get involved it begins to get messy. Create, for example, assigns each bottle as 250 mb of fluid and each bucket at 1000 mb. This is not uncommon for tech mods. The result is the player can use three bottles of water/milk in Farmer's delight and turn it into a bucket which has enough fluid for 4 bottles. A solution to this would be to require 4 bottles to craft the buckets of fluid rather than the current 3. This would result in a loss when only FD is installed but it will remove milk/water materialization when there are tech mods involved.

issues.title: Make support for scavenging super easy
issues.body:
It would be cool if the scavenging loot modifiers were updated to use entity type tags instead of a strict entity type to make them more easily expandable. Example:
The `farmersdelight:scavenging_feather` loot modifier could use a `farmersdelight:scavenging/feather` or `farmersdelight:scavenging_feather` or `farmersdelight:drops_feather` or `farmersdelight:scavenging/drops_feather` entity type tag, just something along those lines, instead of checking `minecraft:chicken` so other mods can just add things to those entity tags. Same could be applied to the other scavenging loot modifiers, especially like leather and string, but all of them would be useful.

issues.title: 1.18.2: Nourishment effect fails when the player would use more than 0.5 food points per second for any reason
issues.body:
**Description**
When FTB Ultimine is being used, the Nourishment effect fails to remove enough exhaustion from the player and the player still loses hunger even if their current food level is below 90%.

More generally, when the player would use more than one food point every 2 seconds, the Nourishment effect stops working completely and the player still starts losing hunger anyway.
For example, if the player is sprinting so fast so as to lose one food point per second, the Nourishment effect only reduces this to half a food point per second instead of stopping completely.

Caused by the `float reduction = Math.min(exhaustion, 0.1F);` limiter here: https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/blob/06b6a70b382d84d59d4cb63f416b0187864fece9/src/main/java/vectorwing/farmersdelight/common/effect/NourishmentEffect.java#L30-L34

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Install Farmer's Delight version 1.1.2 on a new Minecraft 1.18.2 + Forge 40.1.31 instance.
2. Create a new world with cheats enabled.
3. Run: `/gamemode survival`
4. Run: `/effect give @s farmersdelight:nourishment 999`
5. Run `/effect give @s hunger 30 255` to simulate the exhaustion from mining with FTB Ultimine active.

**Expected behavior:**
The Nourishment effect should, at its peak, completely remove all exhaustion from the player regardless of how much exhaustion, therefore not letting the hunger level go down from exhaustion alone.
There could be a config setting to determine how much exhaustion per tick is removed from players that have the Nourishment effect.

**Mod list:**
* Minecraft 1.18.2
* Forge 40.1.31
* Farmer's Delight 1.1.2

issues.title: [1.18.2] Broken interaction with Repurposed Structures and More Villagers mods

labels.name: unrelated
labels.description: Issue is not caused by the mod

issues.body:
After some troubleshooting, it looks like leaving the parameter genVillageCompostHeaps = true in the config fumbles with the built-in limits of structures for Repurposed Structures Villages. Usually, all the "work site" structures in RS are capped at 1, but somehow Farmer's Delight removes that cap, but only for non-FD structures. The result is, that you on average end up with 3 foresters 2 florists and 4 oceanographer houses on average village, leaving no room for vanilla work stations.

Here's a thread where I discussed the issue fith RS author and where we did most of the troubleshooting:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/repurposed-structures-more-villagers-datapack#c10

issues.title: Crop Rotation advancement is unobtainable with berry good installed
issues.body:
**Description**
Berry good makes sweet and glow berries unplacable, and makes so you need to craft them into pips in order to place them, which doesn't count towards the Crop Rotation advancement.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Cooking pot could be inserted and extracted arbitrary items from arbitrary face
issues.body:
Only container items can play a role in the container slot, and only food ingredients can play a role in the input slot, so it is possible to distinguish the slot that an item should be inserted by item itself other than the face where it is inserted. For extracting, actually there is the only need to get the output. Therefore, if cooking pot could be inserted arbitrary items from arbitrary face, it will still work, also this will reduce needed pipes.

(I just want to make Create's mechanical arm able to directly interact with cooking pot \(￣︶￣*\)) , which looks industrially romantic.)

issues.title: [1.18.1] Crash when trying to plant rice on sand
issues.body:
Please fill out the template below to describe your issue. Doing so **greatly** helps us understand what happened!

**Description**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
When I tried to grow rice and right-clicking a sand block after I had cultivated dirt blocks nearby, the game crashed.
**Edit:** This also happens when planted on a gravel block, and probably all blocks that have 1 "water block" above them.

**Steps to reproduce:**
What did you do to cause the issue? Can it be replicated?
1. Start Minecraft 1.18.1 with Forge 39.0.66 and FD 1.0.1.
2. Create a (creative) world and get a rice item (i.e not a panicle).
3. Approach a body of water which has sand.
4. Right-click the sand with the rice.
5. Crash.

**Expected behavior:**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
I expected it to not crash...

**Logs**
Even if the game didn't crash, please submit your client/server logs as well. They contain vital information to troubleshoot the issue.
[latest.log](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/files/8239829/latest.log)


[crash-2022-03-13_15.08.58-server.txt](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/files/8239831/crash-2022-03-13_15.08.58-server.txt)

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Mod list:**
Post a list of your mods here, **Forge and Farmer's Delight versions are mandatory!**
You can generate a mod list by forcing a crash. In your game, hold F3+C for 10 seconds, then check your logs; the list of mods will be by the end.
_Check crash report._

Thank you for helping with the project! Your reports are appreciated!

issues.title: [1.18.1] Wild Rice dropping item without Shears or Silk Touch
issues.body:
Please fill out the template below to describe your issue. Doing so **greatly** helps us understand what happened!

**Description**
When breaking the top half of the Wild Rice block found in swamps or jungles, it drops the item "Wild Rice" which is normally obtained when breaking with Shears or Silk Touch. Breaking the bottom half works as intended. Breaking either with Shears or Silk Touch works as intended.

I have a theory that it may be Create: Alloyed as we have had issues with loot tables related to shears in the past and I wouldn't be surprised.

**Steps to reproduce:**
Find/Place Wild Rice in your world.
Break the top half of the block with an empty hand and receive the "Wild Rice" item
Break the bottom half of the block with an empty hand and receive the "Rice" item
Break either the top or bottom half of the block with Shears and receive the "Wild Rice" item

**Expected behaviour:**
Breaking either half of the Wild Rice block with an empty hand should drop the "Rice" item, rather than the "Wild Rice" item, which is supposed to be obtained when using Shears or Silk Touch

I looked through latest.log and there was nothing of note.

[1.18.1] Server Hangs indefinitely after breaking stove with items on it
issues.body:
**Description**
After placing items onto a stove (in my case, 6 potatoes) and breaking the stove, the items will not be able to be picked up, indicating that the server has frozen. interacting with blocks, attempting to send chat messages, etc, will fail. attempting to close the world (singleplayer) will show the "Saving World" message indefinitely until force-closed. 

**Steps to reproduce:**
Place stove, place 6 Potatoes on stove, break stove

**Expected behavior:**

With Abnormal's & Farmer's Delight installed alongside Autumnity you can make Turkey Pieces by cutting a whole Turkey on a cutting board, right? issues.title: More intuitive interactions with the cutting board
issues.body:
After several hours of playtime I have found interactions with the cutting board somewhat clunky right now (clicks do not do what you'd expect). This suggestion is meant to improve the interaction in the following way.

### Placing items

Currently, a board that already contains an item will have it try to cut on right-click, even if the player isn't wearing a knife or when the item isn't cuttable. Trying to cut should only be done if the player is holding a knife **and** if the item is cuttable, otherwise the item is replaced by whatever the player is holding in his main hand. An exception to the latter is when the item may be added to whatever stack the player is holding. In that case the item is added to the player's hand and the board is cleared. Also if the main hand is empty and the player can't cut, the click retrieves the item and clears the board.

### Cutting items

With a cuttable item in offhand and knife in main hand, this interaction works how you'd expect. The first right-click places the cuttable item down, the second right-click then cuts it with the knife. This behaviour should also be present for a knife in offhand and cuttable item in main hand; currently the cuttable item's right-click behaviour (e.g. eating) overrides this expected behavior.

### Removing items

Copy this behavior from item frames. At any point, items may be removed with left-click.

issues.title: [Forge 39.0.8-9] Lunching Issues
[1.16.5] Off hand items getting placed on cutting board
issues.body:
**Description**
Right clicking most items on the cutting board while also holding something in your off-hand will put the off-hand item on the cutting board instead of the main hand item. However cakes and wheels of cheese in the main hand will still be prioritized over the off-hand.

**Steps to reproduce:**
Hold any non-food in your off-hand, and try to place a raw beef from your main hand on the board. 

**Expected behavior:**
It should probably ignore any non-cuttable off-hand items. While having a stack of cuttable items in the off hand, and a knife in your main, and just right-clicking is quite nice for fast cutting, I'd rather it just ignored the off-hand entirely to stop it stealing my shield. If it could still allow cuttable items to be placed via off-hand, that would obviously be the ideal situation.

**Screenshots**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2611674/147728342-c53f73f8-e941-4dd8-a485-71deb9c7e2c1.png)

**Mod list:**

issues.title: [1.18.1] Mismatched Tags / Missing Required Tags
issues.body:
**Description**
When re-joining a server, I often (not 100% of the time, but definitely more than 50%) will get a failure on connection stating that I am missing required tags to join the server. Restarting the instance resolves this, but may be related to a more critical issue:

On a server, when running `/reload` the process fails due to `Missing required tags: ResourceKey[minecraft:root / minecraft:block]:forge:mineable/knife`.

Since you seem to add a custom tool-type for the knife, I am *pretty* sure that this is a Farmer's Delight issue. If I'm mistaken let me know - there's only one other mod that adds a knife and it's for crafting only (Filet Knife from Aquaculture)

**Steps to reproduce:**
Cannot reliably repro on client.

On server, simply run `/reload` to see failure.

**Expected behavior:**
To not fail to /reload, throwing `Reload failed; keeping old data` message.

**Logs**
[https://gist.github.com/oitsjustjose/290a27e5f27990f7c6776f94fb151234](https://gist.github.com/oitsjustjose/290a27e5f27990f7c6776f94fb151234)

**Mod list:**
**Forge**: 39.0.9
**Farmer's Delight**: 1.18.1-1.0.0

issues.body:
Automation of cooking pots is currently a bit difficult.
May I suggest a blank slot item which will work similar to the 'Crafter Slot Cover' from the create mod. Essentially; when the cooking pot is cooking, this item will always remain in the cooking pot and never be cooked.
An alternative could be to lock slots of the cooking pot to only accept certain items.
This will be useful in automating the cooking pot using only redstone and with the help of no other mods.

issues.title: [1.16.5] Cooking pots not updating comparators properly
issues.body:
**Description**
When the bowl inventory of a cooking pot changes, a comparator reading the cooking pot does not reflect the change unless the comparator is updated (by placing blocks near it or powering it).

**Steps to reproduce:** (Can be replicated)
1. Place cooking pot
2. Place comparator reading cooking pot
3. Put some a sack of items into the bowl part of cooking pot
4. The comparator does not change at all
5. Place a block next to the comparator (updating it)
6. Now it reflects the correct redstone strength

**Expected behaviour:**
The comparator changes its signal strength immediately to show how many items are there in the cooking pot.

issues.title: [Farmers Delight MC 1.16.5] Villagers do not harvest on Rich Soil
issues.body:
I recently swapped the vanilla dirt farmland with the rich soil farmland of the mod and I only planted there the vanilla crops, like potatoes and carrots. After the crops were ready to be harvested the Villagers don't harvest them.

Changed Dirt Farmland with the Rich Soil Farmland and planted with vanilla crops. But the Villagers don't harvest the crops.

issues.title: [1.16.5] Not Enough Chocolate
issues.body:
Good evening. I've spotted a glaring bug in what is otherwise a fantastic mod: There is only one chocolate recipe!

As a lifelong chocolate connoisseur, I was both shocked and horrified to discover there is only one chocolate recipe in the entire mod. After calming myself down, I realized this is _obviously_ an error. Who would deliberately only include 1 recipe for the most important and delicious kind of food to have ever been invented?? And for that recipe to be chocolate pie, as opposed to something more classic, like your basic, run-of-the-mill (but still mouthwateringly delicious) chocolate bar? That would be insanity!

Undoubtedly, you _did_ intend to include more varieties of chocolate treats, such as: milk/dark/white chocolate bars, chocolate biscuits, chocolate truffles, chocolate mini-rolls, chocolate brownies, chocolate chip cookies, chocolate cakes, black forest gateau, chocolate cupcakes, chocolate mousse, chocolate milkshake, chocolate macarons, chocolate crepes, chocolate ice cream, and chocolate soufflés.

But somehow, they just don't show up in the current version. How weird!

I hope this issue can be addressed in future versions, as it is the only flaw I can find in the entirety of this mod. Even the addition of 1-2 more chocolate recipes would go a long way towards improving the situation. Until then, my dream of owning my very own Minecraft Chocolatier shop will have to patiently wait.

P.S. I hope you see this for the tongue-in-cheek suggestion that it is meant to be, and not some serious demand from a deranged chocolate lunatic. I _am_ a deranged chocolate lunatic, but I'm not demanding anything of you. Please keep up the wonderful work, Vectorwing. :)

**Description**
FTB OceanBlock's version got updated from 1.3.0 to 1.4.0 and a NoClassDefFoundError happened for some of our users after the loading and playing the pack.
Your mod's version went from `FarmersDelight-1.16.5-0.4.6.jar` to `FarmersDelight-1.16.5-0.5.0.jar` in those modpack versions.

I see that browsing the files of commit vectorwing/FarmersDelight@0402a2f the class is there as intended. I believe this to be the version you pushed to CurseForge on the same day, August 7 2021 (`FarmersDelight-1.16.5-0.4.6.jar`).

Then, by browsing the files of commit vectorwing/FarmersDelight@64b5b70 the file is no longer at that location. This was committed the day after, or August 8 2021 and in-dev for the next update. By going to `vectorwing/farmersdelight/blocks/crops/TomatoesBlock` we can find that class, so it's been moved, which is fine. Clicking on description and last modifications of that class reorganisation brings us to commit vectorwing/FarmersDelight@f1fede5, which was done on June 16 2021. So it's definitely a bit confusing! Maybe that was on another branch?

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Play OceanBlock 1.3.0, use a HydroponicBedTile to plant a TomatoesBlock.
2. Close the game.
3. Update to 1.4.0, acquire `FarmersDelight-1.16.5-0.5.0.jar` and load the game.
4. Crashes because NoClassDefFound.

**Expected behavior:**
Not crash, or that this change be listed in the changelog, unless I've missed it then I'm sorry.
I see it says "Breaking Changes" although I've not seen that class reorganisation in there.
Our modpack dev usually checks the changelog but that change seems to have been subtile.
You document at https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/wiki/0.5-Breaking-Changes states the following:

> In version 0.5, the old form of Rice has been removed from the game. This means that, if your world still has the old form planted somewhere, these blocks will be erased permanently on world load! So make sure your Rice has been replanted before updating an old save, or else you'll lose your Rice crops!

Blocks would normally be erased as told here but they just crash instead with a Ticking Block Entity. The intended behavior would be that the crops disappear, not crash. If that's not possible after all, read below, Questions section.

**Logs**
Same error for 3 logs, 3 people
https://paste.feed-the-beast.com/view/695ec96c
https://paste.feed-the-beast.com/view/b21b0667
https://hastebin.com/yebelimuye.rust

**Screenshots**
Ticking Block Entity, game crashes, no screenshots.

**Mod list:**
FTB OceanBlock 1.3.0 works fine. `vectorwing.farmersdelight.blocks.TomatoesBlock` and `FarmersDelight-1.16.5-0.4.6.jar`.
FTB OceanBlock 1.4.0 breaks if it contained blocks from 1.3.0. Class def changed to `vectorwing.farmersdelight.blocks.crops.TomatoesBlock` and `FarmersDelight-1.16.5-0.5.0.jar`.

**Questions**
Do you have a solution for our players, since creating a new world with your new version works as intended.
The problem is due to how the class is stored, got moved with the update, and won't load correctly since it no longer exists at that location.
I understand this reorganisation is useful to your mod, but if you have any tips as to prevent/repair this error during transition, please let me know.
Forge's ability to delete Ticking block entities worked for one of our users and your mod's classes will start fresh on that instance. They do lose every Hydroponic Bed that contains the crop though.

issues.title: Comfort and freezing effect?
issues.body:
I believe the new freezing effect in Minecraft 1.17 is a good opportunity to improve one of the few things that I dont like about this mod. The wiki article says that the comfort effect prevents the player from getting cold by blocking the slowness effect. This seems backwards to me, because I know that after a good hot meal all I want to do is curl up on the couch and watch movies until I fall asleep. That wouldn't really fall under immune to slowness. However, I do agree that the comfort effect should somehow prevent the player from getting cold to simulate that warm, cozy feeling. That is why I think it would make more sense for comfort to prevent the player from freezing, or at least slow it down like partial leather armor would. This just seems to make more sense, now that it is an option. 

However, I will say that this is just my opinion, and it isn't necessarily shared by the developers, so I will understand if this change never makes it into the mod.

P.S. This mod is probably my favorite Minecraft mod of all time. Thank you for spending the time to keep development moving forward. It means a lot to me, and all the other fans of FD. <3

issues.title: [1.16.5] Texture Reference Chain Error - With Solution
issues.body:
Please fill out the template below to describe your issue. Doing so **greatly** helps us understand what happened!

**Description**
Texture reference chain errors are thrown when loaded alongside CTM, but the error IS NOT a flaw in CTM as has been claimed on the past several issues opened for this. CTM is exposing an error latent in your mod.

The issue stems from the way that unused parent blocks were exported from BlockBench. There are circular (or null, I suppose) references to textures on these four block models which are all unused in-game and serve only as parents for specific types of pie:

pie.json
pie_slice1.json
pie_slice2.json
pie_slice3.json

Your reference error is here:
	"textures": {
		"particle": "#top",
		"bottom": "#bottom",
		"inner": "#inner",
		"side": "#side",
		"top": "#top"
	},

You should not be trying to evaluate bottom, inner, side, and top to themselves. Simply remove these lines and the errors are resolved. Pie objects in-game are unaffected, as you set these textures appropriate in the child block json.

Without CTM installed this error does not actually DO anything, since the generic Pie block model is unused, but it still an error nonetheless.

**Steps to reproduce:**
Errors are thrown upon game launch

**Mod list:**
FarmersDelight
CTM

issues.title: [Suggestion] Tables
issues.body:
Decorative tables on which to serve your feasts!

I believe the addition of decorative tables would fit the theme of Farmer's Delight. Tables are not all that easy to make nicely in vanilla, with the options being generally trapdoors which open, or slabs and stairs which look too thick, and wool for table coverings either needs a full block or an item-blocking carpet on top. My suggestion is to add a dedicated table with spindly legs that could visually connect to other adjacent tables to become a larger table. The thickness of the table might be three pixels and the legs could be anything from inset, two-pixel-wide legs to flush, sturdy 3-pixel-wide legs (the latter sounds easier to model, but what do I know). Additionally, a table cloth could be added by right clicking a bare table with a carpet, consuming it and changing the top and some fraction of the side texture to wool or perhaps a colour-dependent pattern somewhat like llama carpets or the glazed terracotta blocks. Sneaking while placing the carpet would likely be the way to avoid adding the table cloth. This would result in a table with a clear, usable top surface. Breaking a table block with a table cloth on it would drop both the table and the carpet.

I imagine a table would be crafted something like this, with wooden variants:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26589951/124004564-23010500-d9a6-11eb-8a21-3d3fa8ddeff3.png)

I'm not sure if the combination of different wood types and carpets would result in undesirable multiplication of assets, or if the table cloth part can be separated from the wood variants part.

I'm very much enjoying this mod as it is and I understand that this may fall outside of the scope of Farmer's Delight, in some sort of furniture mod instead. When I found the pantry blocks I instantly changed out my barrels and it looks really nice.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Serene Seasons crop fertility integration

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Looking for contributors to help with this

labels.name: integration
labels.description: Relates to interactions with other mods

issues.body:
[Serene Seasons](https://github.com/Glitchfiend/SereneSeasons) is a mod from the Biome's o Plenty team that adds seasons which (among other things) applies fertility modifiers to crop growth based on the current season. Crops grow extremely slowly or not at all when they are not in season. For example wheat is a summer crop, while carrots grow in spring and autumn.

I suggest specifying fertility tags for the new Farmer's Delight crops. The Serene Seasons team has already implemented default support for Farmer's Delight in [this commit](https://github.com/Glitchfiend/SereneSeasons/commit/0a3d8edeae80307e05856da82d9e1a5d86d9aa48), so all Farmer's Delight crops will grow in spring, summer, and autumn. But to customize these seasons and get the in-game tool-tip that displays fertility I think you need to add a set of tags like [these ones](https://github.com/Glitchfiend/SereneSeasons/tree/SS-1.16.x-4.x.x/src/main/resources/data/sereneseasons/tags).

issues.title: README - How to report issues
issues.body:
First of all, thank you for helping us improve **Farmer's Delight**!

This is a short guide on how to make sure your issue is effective. Please read everything here before posting; breaking the guidelines below may result in it being closed without an answer.

### 1. Have a suggestion? Post it in the Discussions tab!
The Issues board is for problems with the mod; once the problem is resolved in some way, the issue is then closed. I can't really "close" suggestions since they have nothing to be resolved, so they often end up cluttering the Issues board.

If you would like to propose ideas for the mod, please use the **Discussions** tab. In it, posts can be upvoted, and you can reply individually to messages, making it a better place to discuss ideas.

You can find the Discussions tab next to other tabs in this repository:

![image](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/assets/5566692/d922b99d-08f8-47ac-b0ce-643397216250)

### 2. Use the Bug Report template
![image](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/assets/5566692/ce6a113f-5db8-4395-9be3-53ab83081c8e)
This board has a **Bug Report** form set up. Filling this form with all requested information will **greatly** help me figure out what happened, so we can find a solution for it!

### 3. Always search the board before posting an issue
Sometimes you may find a problem that someone else has reported already. Before posting a new issue, use the **search bar** on the issue board to search common words regarding your problem.

For example: if the Stove caused a crash, you could search for "stove" and/or "crash" as keywords and look around. You can remove the `is:open` keyword to show both open and closed issues; your problem might have already been solved!

**Example:**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5566692/121791705-179a9500-cbc3-11eb-8e2f-5bba5d095245.png)

Thank you for taking the time to read this post! Your help is always appreciated. 👍
